latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Commitment Signal Evaluator skill.

- Evaluates customer meetings by classifying commitment signals into time, reputation, and money currencies.
- Helps distinguish real prospect interest from polite enthusiasm or “zombie leads.”
- Guides users to assess whether meetings actually advanced the deal based on observable outcomes and commitment.
- Designed for post-meeting evaluation across sales calls, demos, discovery, and investor conversations.
- Provides clear criteria for input sufficiency and default handling if key context (like product stage) is missing.
